content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media operator billing and network software; does not serve retailers or their trading partners."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Employer payroll, HR and tax outsourcing; different customers and workflows from retail supply chain EDI."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Unattended retail payments and vending telemetry for machine operators; no trading partner or supply chain network."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Billing and customer care software for pay-TV and telecom operators; different customers and workflows."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer service and knowledge software; not supply chain collaboration or document exchange."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"IT sourcing advisory and research subscriptions for enterprise buyers; a consulting business, not a transaction platform."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Merchant POS hardware and payments for restaurants and stores; sells to a single merchant, not a trading partner network."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Developer tools, data integration and file transfer for IT departments; not retail supply chain connectivity."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"CAD, product lifecycle and industrial IoT software for manufacturers; engineering rather than retail trade."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone, meetings and contact center software; communications rather than supply chain transactions."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise marketing and social customer experience platform; no supply chain or trading partner exchange."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Work, content and records management software for enterprises and government; unrelated to retail supply chain."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Go-to-market B2B contact data and sales tools; sells to sales teams, not supply chain trading partners."}]}
